name: obol_flag_hunt_2026_09
description: Thorough post-foothold flag capture. Reads well-known flag files through the existing SSH/WinRM proof channel and records what it actually reads. Not Orange-derived.

source.name: O.B.O.L flag capture methodology
source.notes: Runs a single non-interactive recursive search per OS over an existing proven foothold; a captured flag is proof, not a checkbox.

actions.title: Hunt for flags (Linux)
actions.hypothesis: A Linux foothold should be able to read the engagement flag files; capturing their contents proves the objective.

report.finding: Captured a flag file from the Linux foothold.

commands.note: Thoroughly search the filesystem for the well-known flag files and print each as path:content over the existing non-interactive SSH channel.
commands.run: sshpass -p {{password}} ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 {{user}}@{{target}} find / -xdev -type f -size -4k \( {{flag_inames_linux}} \) -exec grep -H -s . {} +

actions.title: Hunt for flags (Windows)
actions.hypothesis: A Windows WinRM foothold should be able to read the engagement flag files; capturing their contents proves the objective.

report.finding: Captured a flag file from the Windows foothold.

commands.note: Recursively search user profiles for the well-known flag files and print each as ===FLAG:path::content through WinRM PowerShell so output is captured and parsed like every other run.
commands.run: nxc winrm {{target}} -u {{user}} -p {{password}} -X "foreach($f in Get-ChildItem -Path C:\Users -Recurse -Force -Include {{flag_names_windows}} -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){Write-Output ('===FLAG:'+$f.FullName+'::'+(Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $f.FullName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))}"
